name: mod-wrap-up
description: Wrap up: hand off to a fresh session (summarize, /clear, fill the handoff) or fill a /compact that keeps what you pick

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Entries shimmer while they wait. Hover colors also fade. Off, everything draws still

max_words.title: Handoff length
max_words.description: Most words the handoff may use. A hard cap on the message the model writes

pick_threads.title: Read the threads
pick_threads.description: Haiku finds up to four threads. You keep or drop each one when the card opens. Off, the card shows only the fixed items and the whole session counts

auto_handoff.title: Automatic handoff
auto_handoff.description: After a turn, Sonnet keeps a ledger of decisions and tasks and a fresh handoff in the background. /compact is given the handoff, and the next prompt after a compaction or a related /clear carries it. Off, only the Wrap up pill hands off

auto_every.title: Update every
auto_every.description: Turns between automatic handoff updates, at least 1

auto_compact.title: Auto compact
auto_compact.description: Compacts between turns once either mark below is reached, carrying the handoff. Meant for sessions with Claude Code's own auto-compact off. Needs Automatic handoff on

compact_at.title: Compact at
compact_at.description: Context percent at which the mod compacts between turns, carrying the handoff. Guards small windows; the token mark comes first on large ones. 0 turns it off. Kept between 50 and 95

compact_at_tokens.title: Compact at tokens
compact_at_tokens.description: Context tokens at which the mod compacts between turns, whichever of the two marks comes first. 0 turns it off. Kept between 50000 and 1000000

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto picks Nerd Font or safe glyphs. It uses Nerd Font icons when the terminal's font is a Nerd Font, read from Windows Terminal, iTerm2, VS Code, Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm, Alacritty, GNOME Terminal or Konsole, and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one
